dimensions.label: Quality
dimensions.description: Net margin (net income ÷ revenue) on the latest reported period. Higher = higher-quality earnings.

dimensions.label: Assets
dimensions.description: Capital efficiency proxy: revenue ÷ shareholders equity on the latest period. Higher = more productive capital use.

dimensions.label: Revisions
dimensions.description: Sign of the last earnings surprise combined with the forward estimate revision. Positive = analysts chasing beats upward.

dimensions.label: Value
dimensions.description: Inverted P/S multiple (marketCap ÷ trailing 4-quarter revenue). Higher = cheaper on sales.
